_comment: Backup export: requests, with the lookup tables joined in.
This is the full fidelity copy. Nothing is hashed, masked or dropped.
De-identification happens in the second stage, S3 to S3.
joins: each entry adds a readable column next to its ID column. The ID is
kept, not replaced, because it is the join key back to the source.
geometry: these columns are passed through ST_AsText so the file holds
POINT(lon lat) rather than PostGIS hex.
_note: users is deliberately not joined. There is no readable label for a person that is not their identity, and the IDs alone are enough to join back.
